title: SEC3: MockWhoIs defined twice with different signatures
description: harness.rs:63 defines MockWhoIs(pub WhoIsResponse) — always succeeds. e2e.rs:112 defines MockWhoIs(Option<WhoIsResponse>) — can simulate auth failure via None. Same name, different shapes, in adjacent test files. A reader who greps for MockWhoIs finds two definitions and must figure out which one applies. The e2e.rs variant subsumes the harness.rs variant (Some(_) is the always-succeed path). Consider unifying: export the Option<> form from harness.rs or a shared test-utils module, and have e2e.rs import it rather than redeclare it.
